<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 13"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Attuned Electroreceptors](/Feats.aspx?ID=5290) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 20

</column>

---

You grow specialized organs that allow you to detect even the faintest of heartbeats. You can sense living creatures and any creature with the [electricity](/Traits.aspx?ID=586) trait as an [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) sense with a range of 20 feet. This range doubles while you are underwater, though only in the body of water you're in.
name: Attuned Electroreceptors
